paras: The Ethiopian ridgeback agama  (Xenagama zonura), is a species of lizard in the family Agamidae. The species is endemic to the Horn of Africa. It is among the largest species of Xenagama, with snout-to-vent length of males up to 84.5mm.
X. zonura is endemic to Ethiopia, in elevations between 2000 and 2500m. Comparatively to other Xenagama species, X. zonura resides at higher elevations.
